classification_rules: Issue comments are staging evidence and do not count as harvested corpus state.
Native procurement facts may be materialized before serial-level inventory is complete.
Public portal sharing observations may be materialized as directed snapshot evidence without asserting reciprocity or actual query activity.
Unresolved native platform evidence does not block harvest of already-established facts.

findings.finding: The August 19 packet predates recovery of native G/112/25 procurement evidence.
The August 19 packet also predates the accumulated current public portal observations naming RCSO as a sharing recipient.
